item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. It works best when it's boring and automatic. No notes today, so I'm not guessing about your routine. Ask yourself one thing: do I take what I'm prescribed, at the same time, every day? If any dose gets skipped, rushed, or fuzzy, that's the gap to close. Tie it to something you already do daily, like your morning routine. Action: set one recurring phone alarm for your dose, and take it when it goes off.
